name: q2-filter
script: document.getElementById('demo-ribbon')?.remove(); (() => { const i = document.getElementById('msg-filter'); i.value = 'sev:<=4'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); })()

name: q3-trap
script: document.getElementById('demo-ribbon')?.remove(); (() => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = 'dialog[open]{position:fixed;inset:0;margin:auto;}'; document.head.appendChild(s); const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('tr.rowlink')].find(t => /snmptrap/.test(t.textContent)); if (!r) throw new Error('no trap row in the tail'); r.click(); })()
